title: Refund policy
body: Full refund within 14 days of purchase. After that, store credit only. Refunds go back to the original payment method in 5-7 working days.

title: Deploy checklist
body: Run the tests, check the migration on staging, take a database backup, deploy, then watch error rates for 15 minutes.

title: Onboarding a new client
body: Kickoff call, shared folder, brand assets request, first draft in 5 working days.
